item.tib: ma sang 'phrul gyi rdel mo mngon shes rno gsal gyi sgron me
smra seng 'phrul gyi rdel mo mngon shes gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: ces phywa gshen rgyu yi theg sgo mngon shes pra rtags kyi rim pa 'di nyid gangs can gyi mgon po rje 'brug chen po'i gter gzhung la gzhir byas gzhan gyi yig cha khungs thub rnams las don dbyung ste phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas dus snyigs ma'i blo chung rnams kyi rtogs par sla ba'i ched rgyas bshad kyi 'jigs pa dman te lhag bsam rnam par dag pas sbyar bas dus kun mkhas tshul gsum gyi dbang la 'byor ba'i rgyu gyur cig mkhas grub lung rtogs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bka' phran brgya rtsa'i gras su bzhugs pa'i sde'o//
